question: What practice is enjoined for one who, after six months, should practice wearing an ochre robe free from bondage?
premises: A time limit of six months is given.
A relative clause marks the person who should practice.
The object of practice is an ochre robe free from bondage.
inference: After six months, one who is so qualified should practice in relation to an ochre robe free from bondage.
uncertainties: The precise nature of the practice is not fully specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Whoever, after six months, should practice the ochre robe free from bondage.
